bestFor: Compare batch language and remaining syllabus
providers.limitation: Booster and crash packages are not equivalent to a full foundation course.

providers.name: IMS
providers.summary: IMS lists classroom preparation, CATapult self-study and SimCAT test packages. The 30-SimCAT and 40-SimCAT variants should be compared separately.
bestFor: Classroom or self-study with separately specified mocks
providers.limitation: A SimCAT price is not the price of classroom coaching.
providers.officialFeeNote: SimCAT Core 2026 — 30 SimCATs: ₹5,950 + ₹1,071 GST = ₹7,021 (test series only)

providers.name: T.I.M.E.
providers.summary: T.I.M.E. lists CAT self-study packages; its Chennai page also advertises classroom and live online preparation.
bestFor: Compare AIMCAT inclusions and delivery format
providers.limitation: Self-study material pricing does not establish classroom fees.
providers.officialFeeNote: CAT 2026 Self Study Regular: ₹12,250 (self-study course)

providers.name: Career Launcher
providers.summary: Career Launcher offers classroom, online and test-series routes for CAT preparation. Local branches require their own batch and faculty checks.
bestFor: Students comparing a local branch with online delivery
providers.limitation: Obtain a branch-specific quote; no single current national fee is verified here.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Cracku
providers.summary: Cracku lists CAT crash and MBA entrance packages with daily classes, practice targets and mentorship. The course page states validity through January 2027.
bestFor: Scheduled online practice and a crash-course timetable
providers.limitation: Check how much of the batch is already recorded and what OMET coverage the selected package includes.
providers.officialFeeNote: CAT 2026 Crash Course: ₹16,999 (crash course)

providers.name: 2IIM
providers.summary: 2IIM offers live online, self-paced and Chennai classroom routes. Its Test Dojo is a separate mock-test product.
bestFor: Choose between self-paced study, live classes and Chennai classroom
providers.limitation: Confirm exam year: the site displays both 2026 and 2027 programmes.
providers.officialFeeNote: CAT 2026 Percentile Booster live online: ₹55,000 (crash course)

providers.name: iQuanta
providers.summary: iQuanta describes live concept and application classes, expert doubt support, mocks and mentoring. Its support is not accurately described as peer-only.
bestFor: Evaluate concept classes alongside application practice
providers.limitation: Support speed and teaching effectiveness have not been independently tested; request a current demo.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Elites Grid
providers.summary: Elites Grid advertises live classes, recordings, mock analytics and mentoring for CAT.
bestFor: A scheduled live batch with recordings
providers.limitation: The course catalogue did not load reliably during this review, so current fees and batch inclusions remain unverified.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: CATKing
providers.summary: CATKing lists online preparation and a Mumbai-region classroom directory covering Andheri, Borivali and Thane.
bestFor: Compare a named online package or Mumbai classroom
providers.limitation: Package labels and mock totals need checking; do not treat all practice tests as full-length CAT mocks.

providers.summary: The official website describes CAT classroom and online teaching but still displays older batch announcements. A current CAT 2026 intake was not established in this review.

providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: MBA Guru
providers.summary: MBA Guru describes adaptive assessment and modules for CAT, with classroom locations in Delhi and an online course offering.
bestFor: Ask how diagnostic results change your assignments
providers.limitation: Adaptive learning is a provider description, not independently measured improvement.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Alchemist
providers.summary: Alchemist describes assessment-led preparation with online, offline and video options plus faculty and mentor support.
bestFor: Ask for the individual study plan before enrolling
providers.limitation: Specific operating centres and current batch fees need direct confirmation; none are asserted in our city tables.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Tathagat
providers.summary: TathaGat advertises CAT 2026 classroom and online programmes. Its different package pages show different prices and inclusions.
bestFor: Compare the exact Classic or online package
providers.limitation: No uniform fee is quoted here because package pages differ; request the programme name and written total.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Hitbullseye
providers.summary: Hitbullseye describes online learning and physical centres in Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Patiala, Ambala and Yamunanagar. It is not online-only.
bestFor: Online access or a separately confirmed listed physical centre
providers.limitation: Those physical cities are outside the nine city guides reviewed here; online access does not prove a local branch.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Unacademy CAT
providers.summary: Unacademy groups CAT and other MBA entrance preparation by educator and batch.
bestFor: Compare the actual educator timetable and subscription
providers.limitation: Subscription duration and batch access matter more than a generic platform price; current checkout total is not verified.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Physics Wallah MBA
providers.summary: PW MBA lists MBA entrance preparation, including CAT and other entrance exams.
bestFor: Choose a named batch for the correct exam year
providers.limitation: Do not infer that every batch includes all MBA exams or that a low-priced section product is a complete course.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Erudite
providers.summary: Erudite describes classroom and blended CAT preparation in Kolkata.
bestFor: Compare a Kolkata classroom batch and its blended access
providers.limitation: Confirm the teaching branch and current batch quote; the head-office address alone does not establish class timing.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Ascent Education
providers.summary: Ascent’s CAT section directs visitors to 2IIM. It should not be counted as an additional independent CAT option alongside 2IIM.
bestFor: Use the 2IIM profile for CAT course comparison
providers.limitation: Retained as a clarification page, excluded from CAT shortlists.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.name: Proton Training Solutions
providers.summary: A current CAT 2026 programme and working official course page could not be verified. This does not establish that the institute has closed.
bestFor: Request a current official course page and brochure
providers.limitation: Historical listings are insufficient to confirm current fees, locations or delivery mode.
providers.officialFeeNote: Current package fee not verified; request a written quote.

providers.summary: The reviewed official site promotes JEE, NEET and school programmes. A current CAT course was not found.
bestFor: For CAT in Patna, use a provider with a confirmed CAT listing
